put.description: Mark an entire order as shipped or partially shipped.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

items[].orderItemID.description: When the Items array is included in this request, one of: OrderItemID or ProductID or Sku is required.

items[].productID.description: Identifies the item by Product ID. (conditionally required)

items[].sku.description: (conditionally required) Identifies the SKU (as defined by the seller).

items[].quantity.description: Required if the Items array is included in this request.

items[].sellerFulfillmentItemID.description: (optional) Identifier provided by the seller. Usually a serial number or batch number.

deliveryStatus.description: Complete is the most common status used. See all here: https://knowledge.channeladvisor.com/kc?id=kb_article_view&sys_id=c568b05533206e10ae51a5373e5c7b0e&spa=1#concept-89__section-3115

items[].description: (optional) A list of items to mark as shipped for this order. Leaving this array empty will mark the entire order as shipped.

put.description: Update Product Quantity at one or more Distribution Centers.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

productID.description: The Rithum-defined unique ID (not the Sku value) of the product you want to update quantities for.

updates[].quantity.description: Available Quantity for the product at the Distribution Center ID provided.

updateType.description: This value determines how the platform will interpret the quantity.

updates[].description:
A list of Qtys for this product at each Distribution Center. 
*Note: 'Quantity' and 'Distribution Center ID' are required arguments*
